fact: The e-PS has been in service since 28 September 2015 and is mandated for all public bodies by Directive No. 47 (21 August 2020), but 83 of 205 public bodies used it in 2020/21 and 91 in 2021/22, use is mainly low-value, and evaluation of bids is predominantly offline.
title: Assessment of Mauritius e-Procurement: Testing the MAPS Module on E-Procurement
publisher: African Development Bank / Procurement Policy Office
